therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Individuals with mild Alzheimer's disease who are currently driving
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of subjects able to pass the DriveABLE On-Road Test at Month 12

results.effect_size: 13 of memantine vs 10 of placebo passed DriveABLE at 12 months
biomarker_changes: MMSE at 12 months: memantine 27.15 vs placebo 26.00
ADAS-Cog total components showed modest differences favoring memantine on orientation and comprehension
CDR at 12 months: memantine 1.81 vs placebo 2.31
Fuld Object Memory Evaluation 12-month sum of retrieval: memantine 17.94 vs placebo 19.08
Trail Making Test Part B at 12 months: memantine 170.92s vs placebo 233.15s
subgroup_findings: DriveABLE passed at 12 months: memantine 13, placebo 10
DriveABLE same or improved at 12 months: memantine 13, placebo 9
Trail Making Test Part A at 12 months: memantine 38.54s vs placebo 53.46s
Useful Field of View at 12 months: memantine 2.08 vs placebo 2.54
safety_signals: Serious adverse events reported: mouth cancer (memantine, n=1), myocardial infarction (memantine, n=1), generalized weakness (placebo, n=1), stroke (placebo, n=1), rectal carcinoma (placebo, n=1)
